newsitem.title: HUNGARY: OTP surges on EBRD loan, market sentiment.
newsitem.headline: OTP surges on EBRD loan, market sentiment.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian OTP Bank surged on Thursday, benefiting from positive market sentiment enhanced by a news of an EBRD loan to the bank, an analyst said.
OTP stocks opened at 2,730 forints, above Wednesday's close of 2,720 forints, and rose to 2,870 forints. At 1149 GMT OTP shares stood at 2,860, up 140.
The stock saw strong volume of almost 230,000 shares, including deals for 104,000 stocks and 50,000 stocks, at 2,750 forints in both cases.

"The market is bullish and in addition, news like this may have given extra help," an analyst, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said. The fact that the U.S. Fed left its interest rates steady, was another factor for the whole market.
The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) announced earlier it was to provide a $50 million, ten-year subordinated loan for Hungary's biggest commercial bank, OTP.
